title: You Put That Jazz In My Heart
lyrics:
[Verse]
So, I’m as blue as can be
’Til you put that jazz in my heart
Yes, I’m as blue as can be
’Til you put that jazz in my heart

[Pre-Chorus]
Then it’s goodbye gloom
And goodbye despair
Hello, my moonbeam
And the wind in my hair
Oh, life is so carefree
When you put that jazz in my heart

[Chorus]
Oh, you put that jazz in my heart
Yes, you put that jazz in my heart
You turned my frown upside down
Oh, you put that jazz in my heart

[Pre-Chorus]
You turned my frown upside down
When you put that jazz in my heart
